correctness.rationale: Every top simplex is a directed Hamiltonian path of a simple cycle and the top chain splits into two independently primitive embedded sphere cycles. The cited 2026 theorem supplies exact integral low homology and high connectivity. For n≥5, Hurewicz realizes every lower generator as a sphere and Whitehead upgrades the resulting integral homology equivalence to homotopy equivalence. At n=4 an explicit ten-bridge ten-triangle cyclic relation graph gives simple connectivity; n=3 and n=2 have completely identified mixed-face patterns. A standalone checker executes independent finite enumerations, signed top boundary tests and exact mod-two ranks through n=9. The all-parameter proof is deductive from cited premises rather than finite extrapolation.

value.rationale: The primary 2026 paper explicitly posed the wedge-of-spheres problem and established non-shellability. The result resolves the natural whole-family nonequivariant homotopy classification, including every low-dimensional exceptional case and the exact disconnected triangle behavior. It supplies actual integral homotopy equivalences, a topological mechanism via embedded orientation spheres, and an explicit van Kampen solution of the five-vertex boundary, not merely recalculated Betti numbers.
